usage: The word '爺爺' is used to refer specifically to one's paternal grandfather.
It is a noun that names a family member and usually appears as the subject or object in sentences.
'爺爺' can be used with possessive pronouns, such as '我嘅爺爺' (my grandpa).
You can use '爺爺' when asking about or talking to your paternal grandfather directly.
This word is commonly used in everyday conversation to show respect and affection.
